sources.title: PI-Desktop readme
sources.locator: README.md §§Packages; Continue from your phone; Built on Pi; When one agent is not enough; Local-first; Already using another coding agent?
sources.finding: Describes desktop packages, optional paired LAN WebUI, Pi engine, persistent sessions, background subagents and durable Worker Sessions. Local imports from Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode are session-history intake, not executable adapter support.

sources.title: PI-Desktop packages-agent-runtime-src-native-pi-session-ts
sources.locator: Lines 20–33 and 1368–1400, imports from @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent and createAgentSession({cwd,agentDir,...})
sources.finding: Native Pi sessions are opened with Pi SessionManager and createAgentSession, then extensions bound to the SDK session. This establishes an actual coding-agent integration rather than a provider/model alias.

sources.title: PI-Desktop docs-adr-0237-session-orchestrator-as-a-plugin-md
sources.finding: Accepted ADR 0237 specifies the official pi.session-orchestrator plugin and SessionTask spawn/send/supervise/status/wait/result/accept/cancel/list, inherited durable worker sessions, bounded polling/concurrency and persisted parent/worker metadata. The architecture text is documentation, not inspected plugin implementation.

sources.title: PI-Desktop apps-desktop-electron-main-runtime-scheduled-runner-ts
sources.locator: executeScheduledTask and createScheduledRunner, especially host scheduled.run/scheduled.due and 30,000ms polling interval
sources.finding: Desktop-owned runner polls admitted due tasks and launches work while running; confirms implementation beyond the accepted scheduling ADR.

sources.title: PI-Desktop docs-adr-scheduled-desktop-automations-md
sources.finding: Host persists schedules/run ledger; desktop dispatches. Saved permissions default Ask. Daily/weekly follow host timezone, hourly elapsed-hour cadence; app must run; more than ninety seconds late is skipped, overlapping active occurrence suppressed. ADR explicitly adds no cloud execution, OS service or arbitrary cron. Later amendments may refine these rules.

sources.title: PI-Desktop crates-host-core-src-session_worktrees-delegate-rs
sources.locator: Module comments lines 1–13, create_delegate_worktree and settle_delegate_worktree
sources.finding: Isolated delegate worktrees branch from a session branch. Completion commits delegate changes and merges into the session using the project merge algorithm; conflicts stay in the delegate worktree, parent only fast-forwarded, never force. Read-only or non-isolated delegates may have no worktree.

sources.title: PI-Desktop docs-privacy-policy-md
sources.finding: No application-operated remote analytics/crash pipeline; crash dumps stay local. Official plugin download resolver sends a machine-derived device digest for counts/rate limits; update/catalog/OAuth/media requests and model/plugin/MCP destinations have separate data flows. Agent tools/plugins run with user OS privileges; plugin capability sandbox incomplete.

sources.title: PI-Desktop docs-adr-0095-vendor-account-oauth-login-md
sources.finding: Vendor-account OAuth is app-orchestrated over Pi provider flows and encrypted secrets, with per-request resolution; examples discuss Claude/ChatGPT/Copilot subscribers, not external coding CLI integrations.
